state.message: I've been waiting 45 minutes for room service. If it isn't here in 10 I want my money back.

criteria.room_service: Food or drink orders delivered to the room, and their delays
criteria.housekeeping: Cleaning, towels, blankets, linen and amenities
criteria.front_desk: Key cards, check-in/out, billing and general requests
criteria.unknown: No clear request for any of these teams

mentions_refund.instructions: Does `message` ask for a refund or say the guest wants their money back?

criteria.true: A refund, compensation or money back is requested or demanded, even conditionally
criteria.false: No refund or money back is mentioned

anger.instructions: How angry is the guest who wrote `message`?
